integrity: Analytical argument and exact independent finite checker included; no claim of independent scientific audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for complete-split graphs with both class sizes at least two and two positive edge-weight orbits.
The probability law is uniform over distinct vertices, not interior volume or a random-edge coefficient law.
At zero clique weight the graphical fan and the vertex law change, so limiting infima over strictly positive weights are not statements at zero weight.
Finite exact computations supplement but do not establish the infinite-parameter proof.
Historical priority against all equivalent formulations has not been independently certified.
title: Exact covariance-conditioning plateaus in weighted complete-split graphical zonotopes
